/** Executes the exact injected CloudSignInPlugin methods with synthetic HTTPS/store/bridge facades.

public class CloudSignInChainTest extends ChainPluginBase {

 /** Delayed main-thread work runs only when a scenario drains it. */
 static class Handler { final ArrayDeque<Runnable> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();final List<Long> delays=new ArrayList<>(); void postDelayed(Runnable task,long delay){delays.add(delay);queue.add(task);} void drain(){while(!queue.isEmpty())queue.remove().run();} }
 static final String ID="00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";

 static class PluginCall {
  final Map<String,Object> input=new HashMap<>();JSObject result;String error;
  String getString(String key){Object value=input.get(key);return value instanceof String?(String)value:null;}
  JSObject getData(){JSObject data=new JSObject();for(var entry:input.entrySet())data.put(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue());return data;}
  void resolve(JSObject value){result=value;}
  void resolve(){resolve(new JSObject());}
  void reject(String message,String code){error=code;}
 }

 static class Attempt {
  final CloudSignInEnvironment environment=TestRegistration.PRODUCTION;

 <T> T withCredentialRead(java.util.concurrent.Callable<T> read)throws Exception{synchronized(slots){return read.call();}}
 CloudCredentialSlots credentials(Runnable guard){
  return new CloudCredentialSlots(){
   public String read(String key){return slots.get(key);}
   public void write(String key,String value){guard.run();slots.put(key,value);events.add(key.startsWith("cloud:")?"key":"receipt");}
   public void remove(String key){guard.run();slots.remove(key);}
   public boolean compareExchange(String key,String expected,String value){synchronized(slots){guard.run();if(!Objects.equals(slots.get(key),expected))return false;if(value==null)slots.remove(key);else slots.put(key,value);return true;}}
  };
 }
 /** A newer credential intent supersedes this sign-in only when the fixture says so. */
 Runnable reserveCredentialCommit(){reserved++;long mine=++intent;return ()->{if(mode.equals("superseded"))intent++;if(mine!=intent)throw new IllegalStateException("stale intent");};}
 CloudCredentialSlots store(){return credentials(()->{if(destroyed)throw new IllegalStateException("closed");});}

 Response post(Attempt current,String path,JSONObject body,String bearer)throws Exception{
  return post(current,current.environment,path,body,bearer);
 }
 Response post(Attempt current,CloudSignInEnvironment environment,String path,JSONObject body,String bearer)throws Exception{
  requests++;
  if(path.equals(CloudEmailCode.SEND_PATH)||path.equals(CloudSmsCode.SEND_PATH)){
   reservedAtSend=(int)reserved;
   boolean unguarded=false;try{current.credentialGuard.run();}catch(IllegalStateException unsent){unguarded=true;}
   check(unguarded,"an unsent code holds no credential intent");
   if(mode.equals("send-refused"))return new Response(429,new JSONObject());
   if(mode.equals("send-offline"))throw new java.io.IOException("synthetic transport failure");
   return new Response(202,new JSONObject().put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+600000));
  }
  if(path.equals("/steward/auth/oauth/exchange")){
   check(!slots.containsKey(config().pendingSlot),"pending consumed before legacy exchange");
   if (mode.equals("browser-mfa")) return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("mfaRequired",true).put("mfa",new JSONObject().put("type","totp").put("challengeId","fixture").put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+30000)));
   return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("token","synthetic-steward-token-for-fixture"));
  }
  if(path.equals(CloudEmailCode.VERIFY_PATH)||path.equals(CloudSmsCode.VERIFY_PATH)||path.startsWith("/steward/auth/mfa/")){
   if(mode.equals("bad-code")||mode.equals("mfa-denied"))return new Response(401,new JSONObject());
   if(mode.equals("invalid-mfa"))return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("mfaRequired",true).put("mfa",new JSONObject().put("type","unknown").put("challengeId","fixture").put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+60000)));
   return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("token","synthetic-steward-token-for-fixture"));
  }
  if(path.equals("/api/v1/app-auth/connect")){
   check(events.contains("authorization"),"native authorization precedes account connection");
   if(mode.equals("config-denied"))return new Response(503,new JSONObject());
   check("ai.example.signin".equals(body.getString("clientId")),"client binding");
   check("Example Phone".equals(body.getString("deviceName")),"device label");
   check(environment.name.equals(body.getString("environment")),"environment binding");
   check(environment.callback().equals(body.getString("redirectUri")),"redirect binding");
   check("S256".equals(body.getString("codeChallengeMethod")),"S256 required");
   issuedState=body.getString("state");issuedChallenge=body.getString("codeChallenge");
   check(CloudSignInFlow.validState(issuedState),"fresh state");
   return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("codeType","mobile_app_auth_code").put("code","emac_"+"a".repeat(64)).put("accountCreated",false));
  }
  if(path.equals("/api/v1/app-auth/mobile/token")){
   check(issuedState.equals(body.getString("state")),"token state");
   check(issuedChallenge.equals(CloudSignInFlow.s256(body.getString("codeVerifier"))),"token PKCE");
   if(mode.equals("token-denied"))return new Response(401,new JSONObject());
   if(mode.equals("cancelled"))current.cancelled=true;
   return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("secret",mode.equals("bad-secret")?"wrong-prefix":NEW).put("credentialId",ID).put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+(mode.equals("expired-token")?-1:60000)).put("acknowledgeBy",System.currentTimeMillis()+30000).put("acknowledgementRequired",!mode.equals("missing-ack-contract")).put("tokenType","Bearer"));
  }
  if(path.equals("/api/v1/app-auth/mobile/ack")){
   events.add("ack");ackedSecret=body.getString("secret");check(issuedState.equals(body.getString("state")),"ack state");
   if(mode.equals("intent-after-commit")||mode.equals("replacement-after-commit")){
    if(mode.equals("intent-after-commit"))intent++;
    slots.put(config().credentialSlot(environment),new JSONObject().put("credentialId",REQUEST).put("token",OLD).put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+60000).toString());
   }
   if(mode.equals("cancel-after-commit"))cancel(new PluginCall());
   if(mode.equals("destroy-after-commit")){destroyed=true;attempt.cancel();attempt=null;}
   if(mode.equals("replace-after-commit"))attempt=new Attempt(ID);
   if(mode.equals("retained-completion"))attempt.waiting=null;
   check(issuedChallenge.equals(CloudSignInFlow.s256(body.getString("codeVerifier"))),"ack PKCE");
   return new Response(200,new JSONObject().put("status","acknowledged").put("credentialId",mode.equals("wrong-ack")?UUID.randomUUID().toString():ID));
  }
  if(path.equals("/steward/auth/logout")){events.add("logout");return new Response(200,new JSONObject());}
  throw new AssertionError("unexpected route");
 }

 static void check(boolean value,String label){if(!value)throw new AssertionError(label);}
 static void scenario(String mode,boolean authenticated,boolean committed)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();revoked.clear();
  slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("token",OLD).toString());
  slots.put("cloud:staging","preserved-other-environment");
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode=mode;
  Attempt request=new Attempt();request.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=request;
  if(mode.equals("newer-intent"))host.intent++;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();call.input.put("attemptId",request.id);call.input.put("code","123456");
  boolean mfa=mode.startsWith("mfa-");
  if(mfa){request.mfaType=mode.equals("mfa-unsupported")?"passkey":"totp";request.mfaChallenge="fixture";}
  if(mode.equals("expired-attempt"))request.expiresAt=0;
  host.verify(call,mfa);
  boolean actual=call.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(call.result.optString("status"));
  check(actual==authenticated,"authentication outcome "+mode);
  String stored=slots.get("cloud:production");check(NEW.equals(new JSONObject(stored).optString("token"))==committed,"key commit "+mode);
  check("preserved-other-environment".equals(slots.get("cloud:staging")),"environment isolation "+mode);
  if(events.contains("authorization"))check(events.get(events.size()-1).equals("logout")||events.contains("logout"),"the Steward session is revoked "+mode);
  if(authenticated){check(!call.result.has("attemptId")&&!call.result.has("credentialId")&&!call.result.has("requestId"),"legacy awaited outcome remains compatible");check(events.indexOf("receipt")<events.indexOf("key")&&events.indexOf("key")<events.indexOf("ack"),"durable receipt ordering");check(events.indexOf("revoke")>events.indexOf("ack"),"old key revoked only after ack");}
  else check(call.error!=null,"failure is explicit "+mode);
  check(revoked.equals(authenticated?List.of(OLD):List.of()),"only the replaced key is revoked, and only on success "+mode);
  if(mode.equals("wrong-ack"))check("activation-pending".equals(call.error)&&slots.containsKey(TestRegistration.PRODUCT.receiptSlot(request.environment)),"unacknowledged receipt retained");
  if(mode.equals("superseded"))check(!events.contains("ack")&&!events.contains("key"),"a superseded commit writes no key and sends no ack");
  if(mode.equals("consent-denied"))check(!events.contains("receipt")&&!events.contains("key")&&host.issuedState==null&&"cancelled".equals(call.error),"declined consent connects nothing and writes no key");
 }
 static void completedOwnerScenario(String mode,String requestId)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode=mode;
  Attempt original=new Attempt(requestId);original.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=original;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();call.input.put("attemptId",original.id);call.input.put("code","123456");
  host.verify(call,false);
  JSONObject saved=new JSONObject(slots.get("cloud:production"));
  check(NEW.equals(saved.getString("token")),"post-commit cancellation never pretends rollback");
  if(mode.equals("retained-completion")){
   check(call.result==null&&notifications.size()==1,"unclaimed current completion is retained once");
   JSObject outcome=notifications.get(0);
   if(requestId!=null){
    check(original.id.equals(outcome.getString("attemptId")),"retained native attempt identity");
    check(saved.getString("credentialId").equals(outcome.getString("credentialId")),"retained committed local credential identity");
   }else{
    check(!outcome.has("attemptId")&&!outcome.has("credentialId"),"legacy strict parser has no correlation extras");
    check(outcome.length()==4&&outcome.has("status")&&outcome.has("environment")&&outcome.has("expiresAt")&&outcome.has("accountCreated"),"legacy retained outcome exact shape");
   }
   check(Objects.equals(requestId,outcome.optString("requestId",null)),"retained caller identity is exact or unscoped legacy");
   check(!outcome.toString().contains(NEW),"completion does not expose credential");
  }else if(mode.equals("valid")){
   check(call.result!=null&&REQUEST.equals(call.result.getString("requestId")),"scoped RPC outcome retains caller identity");
  }else{
   check(call.result==null&&notifications.isEmpty(),"retired owner cannot deliver completion: "+mode);
   if(mode.equals("cancel-after-commit"))check("cancelled".equals(call.error),"cancel acknowledges waiting call");
   if(mode.equals("replace-after-commit"))check(host.attempt!=null&&host.attempt!=original,"old finish preserves replacement attempt");
  }
 }
 static void mfaScope(boolean retained,boolean verifyPath)throws Exception{
  notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();Attempt current=new Attempt(REQUEST);host.attempt=current;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();if(!retained)current.waiting=call;
  JSONObject challenge=new JSONObject().put("mfaRequired",true).put("mfa",new JSONObject().put("type","totp").put("challengeId","fixture").put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+30000));
  if(verifyPath)host.completeOrRequireMfa(current,challenge);else host.complete(current,challenge);
  JSObject result=retained?notifications.get(0):call.result;
  check(result!=null&&"mfa".equals(result.getString("status")),"native MFA result");
  check(REQUEST.equals(result.getString("requestId"))&&current.id.equals(result.getString("attemptId")),"MFA retains caller and native identity");
  check(!result.has("credentialId"),"MFA has no committed credential yet");
 }
 static void callbackOwner(String mode)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
  CloudSignInFlow.Pending pending=CloudSignInFlow.Pending.create(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION,System.currentTimeMillis());
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,pending.serialize());
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.google=true;owner.browserLaunched=true;owner.browserState=pending.state;owner.pendingRecord=pending.serialize();owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();owner.waiting=call;
  if(!mode.equals("cold-after-signout"))host.attempt=owner;
  if(mode.equals("cold-after-signout"))host.intent++;
  if(mode.equals("live-after-signout"))host.intent++;
  Intent callback=new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+"#code=fixture-code&state="+pending.state);
  check(host.captureCallback(callback)&&callback.getData()==null,"registered callback consumed");
  check(host.reserved==1,"callback never reserves a new credential intent");
  check(mode.equals("live") ? !slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot) : slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot),"only live current intent consumes browser pending");
  if(mode.equals("live"))check(call.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(call.result.optString("status")),"live supported callback keeps its accepted owner");
  else check(!slots.containsKey("cloud:production"),"newer signout cannot be undone by an old callback");
  if(mode.equals("cold-after-signout"))check(host.requests==0&&events.contains("signInIncomplete"),"unbound cold callback requires fresh sign-in before network");
 }
 static void browserCallbackRaces()throws Exception{
  for(String outcome:List.of("foreign", "duplicate", "browser-mfa", "cancelled", "stale-attempt")){
   slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode=outcome;
   CloudSignInFlow.Pending pending=CloudSignInFlow.Pending.create(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION,System.currentTimeMillis());
   slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,pending.serialize());
   Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.google=true;owner.browserLaunched=true;owner.browserState=pending.state;owner.pendingRecord=pending.serialize();owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;owner.waiting=new PluginCall();
   PluginCall waiting=owner.waiting;
   if(outcome.equals("cancelled")){PluginCall cancel=new PluginCall();cancel.input.put("requestId",REQUEST);host.cancel(cancel);}
   if(outcome.equals("stale-attempt"))owner.browserState=CloudSignInFlow.newState();
   String state=outcome.equals("foreign")?CloudSignInFlow.newState():pending.state;
   host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+"#code=fixture-code&state="+state));
   if(outcome.equals("duplicate")){
    int before=host.requests;host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+"#code=fixture-code&state="+state));check(host.requests==before,"duplicate browser return cannot exchange twice");
   }else if(outcome.equals("browser-mfa")){
    check(waiting.result!=null&&"mfa".equals(waiting.result.getString("status"))&&REQUEST.equals(waiting.result.getString("requestId")),"browser MFA retains request correlation");
    check(host.attempt==owner&&!owner.busy&&!slots.containsKey("cloud:production"),"browser MFA waits before credential issue");
   }else check(host.requests==0&&!slots.containsKey("cloud:production"),"foreign, cancelled or older browser return cannot authenticate: "+outcome);
  }
 }
 static void scopedCancel(String mode)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  owner.mfaType="totp";owner.mfaChallenge="fixture";
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,"old-pending");
  PluginCall cancel=new PluginCall();
  if(!mode.equals("legacy"))cancel.input.put("requestId",mode.equals("malformed")?"invalid":mode.equals("stale")?ID:REQUEST);
  if(mode.startsWith("queued"))host.defer=true;
  host.cancel(cancel);
  if(mode.equals("stale")||mode.equals("malformed")){
   check(host.attempt==owner&&!owner.cancelled&&"old-pending".equals(slots.get(host.config().pendingSlot)),"stale/malformed cancel cannot retire MFA or burn state");
   check(mode.equals("malformed")?"invalid-request".equals(cancel.error):cancel.result!=null,"cancel outcome is explicit");
  }else{
   check(owner.cancelled&&host.attempt==null,"matching or legacy cancel retires owner");
   check(mode.startsWith("queued")?cancel.result==null:cancel.result!=null,"cancellation settles only after durable retirement");
   if(mode.startsWith("queued")){
    Attempt newer=new Attempt(ID);newer.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=newer;
    if(mode.equals("queued-completed"))host.attempt=null;
    slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,"new-pending");while(!host.queued.isEmpty())host.queued.remove().run();
    check(!newer.cancelled&&"new-pending".equals(slots.get(host.config().pendingSlot)),"queued old cleanup cannot erase remounted owner");
    check(cancel.result!=null,"durable retirement resolves after its queued CAS");
   }else check(!slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot),"owned pending removed");
  }
 }
 static void changedAfterCommit(String mode)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode=mode;
  Attempt original=new Attempt(REQUEST);original.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=original;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();call.input.put("attemptId",original.id);call.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(call,false);
  check(call.result==null&&"state-mismatch".equals(call.error),"old direct completion refused: "+mode);
  check(notifications.isEmpty(),"no stale retained completion: "+mode);
  check(REQUEST.equals(new JSONObject(slots.get(host.config().credentialSlot(original.environment))).getString("credentialId")),"successor kept: "+mode);
 }
 static void credentialIdentityReads()throws Exception{
  slots.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
  PluginCall missing=new PluginCall();missing.input.put("environment","production");host.credentialIdentity(missing);
  check(missing.result!=null&&missing.result.opt("credentialId")==JSONObject.NULL,"missing identity");
  slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("credentialId",REQUEST).put("token",NEW).put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+60000).toString());
  PluginCall current=new PluginCall();current.input.put("environment","production");host.credentialIdentity(current);
  check(REQUEST.equals(current.result.getString("credentialId"))&&current.result.length()==2,"only current identity and environment returned");
  slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("credentialId",REQUEST).put("token",NEW).put("expiresAt",1).toString());
  PluginCall expired=new PluginCall();expired.input.put("environment","production");host.credentialIdentity(expired);
  check(expired.result.opt("credentialId")==JSONObject.NULL,"expired identity not active");
 }
 /** A resend that fails keeps the code already sent; one that succeeds retires it and only then takes the credential intent. */
 static void resend(String mode,boolean phone)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode=mode;
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,"superseded-google-pending");
  Attempt sent=new Attempt(REQUEST);sent.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=sent;
  if(phone){sent.phone="+15555550100";sent.email=null;}
  PluginCall resend=new PluginCall();resend.input.put("environment","production");
  if(phone){resend.input.put("phone","+15555550100");host.startPhone(resend);}else{resend.input.put("email","owner@example.invalid");host.startEmail(resend);}
  check(host.reservedAtSend==1,"the new code's credential intent is not reserved before the send: "+mode);
  boolean ok=mode.equals("send-ok");
  check(ok?resend.result!=null:resend.error!=null,"send outcome explicit: "+mode);
  check(slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot)!=ok,"a sent code burns a superseded Google record; a failed send keeps it: "+mode);
  check(host.reserved==(ok?2:1),"credential intent reserved only after a successful send: "+mode);
  check(sent.cancelled==ok&&(host.attempt==sent)!=ok,"the code already sent stays live only when the resend fails: "+mode);
  PluginCall old=new PluginCall();old.input.put("attemptId",sent.id);old.input.put("code","123456");
  host.verify(old,false,phone);
  if(!ok){check(old.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(old.result.optString("status")),"the first code still verifies after a failed resend: "+mode);return;}
  check("expired".equals(old.error),"the replaced code no longer verifies");
  PluginCall fresh=new PluginCall();fresh.input.put("attemptId",resend.result.getString("attemptId"));fresh.input.put("code","123456");
  host.verify(fresh,false,phone);
  check(fresh.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(fresh.result.optString("status"))&&NEW.equals(new JSONObject(slots.get("cloud:production")).getString("token")),"the new code verifies and commits");
 }
 /** A parameterless RETURN is only a hint: a SUCCESS within the grace still exchanges; alone it ends the step without burning. */
 static void returnHint(boolean success)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
  CloudSignInFlow.Pending pending=CloudSignInFlow.Pending.create(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION,System.currentTimeMillis());
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,pending.serialize());
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.google=true;owner.browserLaunched=true;owner.browserState=pending.state;owner.pendingRecord=pending.serialize();owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();owner.waiting=call;
  check(host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback())),"parameterless return consumed");
  check(host.attempt==owner&&!owner.cancelled&&!owner.callbackReceived&&call.error==null&&host.requests==0,"a return alone does not end the attempt");
  check(host.main.queue.size()==1&&host.main.delays.get(0)==BROWSER_RETURN_GRACE_MS,"the return waits out the grace");
  if(success)host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+"#code=fixture-code&state="+pending.state));
  host.main.drain();
  if(success)check(call.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(call.result.optString("status")),"a SUCCESS after a return still exchanges");
  else check("app-link-unverified".equals(call.error)&&host.attempt==null&&slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot)&&host.requests==0,"a lone return ends after the grace and burns nothing");
 }
 /**
  * The owner came back from the browser and its grace check fires while the return's worker is still
  * queued. Its own return is claimed first and still exchanges; another app's state does not claim;
  * a claimed return with no readable pending record ends as browser-closed instead of hanging.
  */
 static void graceRace(String mode)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.defer=true;
  CloudSignInFlow.Pending pending=CloudSignInFlow.Pending.create(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION,System.currentTimeMillis());
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,mode.equals("unreadable")?"not-a-pending-record":pending.serialize());
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.google=true;owner.browserLaunched=true;owner.browserState=pending.state;owner.pendingRecord=pending.serialize();owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();owner.waiting=call;
  host.handleOnPause();host.handleOnResume();
  String state=mode.equals("foreign")?CloudSignInFlow.newState():pending.state;
  host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+"#code=fixture-code&state="+state));
  check(owner.returnClaimed!=mode.equals("foreign"),"only the owner's own state claims the return: "+mode);
  host.main.drain();
  if(mode.equals("foreign"))check("browser-closed".equals(call.error)&&host.attempt==null,"a foreign App Link leaves the grace check to end the attempt");
  else check(host.attempt==owner&&!owner.cancelled&&call.error==null,"the grace check leaves a claimed return to its worker: "+mode);
  while(!host.queued.isEmpty())host.queued.remove().run();
  if(mode.equals("own"))check(call.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(call.result.optString("status"))&&!slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot),"a claimed return still exchanges after the grace check");
  else check(call.result==null&&"browser-closed".equals(call.error)&&host.attempt==null&&!owner.returnClaimed&&host.requests==0,"an unconsumable return ends as browser-closed: "+mode);
 }
 /** A result admitted before the hint timer expires owns the decision while its worker waits. */
 static void hintGraceRace(boolean readable)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.defer=true;
  CloudSignInFlow.Pending pending=CloudSignInFlow.Pending.create(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION,System.currentTimeMillis());
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,pending.serialize());
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.google=true;owner.browserLaunched=true;owner.browserState=pending.state;owner.pendingRecord=pending.serialize();owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();owner.waiting=call;
  host.handleOnPause();host.handleOnResume();
  host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()));
  host.queued.remove().run();
  check(owner.returnHint&&host.main.queue.size()==2,"hint and resume grace are both queued");
  host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+"#code=fixture-code&state="+pending.state));
  if(!readable)slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,"not-a-pending-record");
  check(owner.returnClaimed,"the matching result claimed its owner before hint grace");
  host.main.drain();
  check(host.attempt==owner&&call.error==null,"hint grace leaves a claimed return to its worker");
  while(!host.queued.isEmpty())host.queued.remove().run();
  if(readable)check(call.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(call.result.optString("status"))&&!slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot),"claimed result exchanges after hint grace");
  else check(call.result==null&&"app-link-unverified".equals(call.error)&&host.attempt==null&&!owner.returnClaimed&&host.requests==0&&slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot),"unconsumable claimed result releases the elapsed hint without burning");
 }
 /** A return already queued when its owner cancels says nothing afterwards. */
 static void queuedBehindCancel(boolean success)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.defer=true;
  CloudSignInFlow.Pending pending=CloudSignInFlow.Pending.create(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION,System.currentTimeMillis());
  slots.put(host.config().pendingSlot,pending.serialize());
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.google=true;owner.browserLaunched=true;owner.browserState=pending.state;owner.pendingRecord=pending.serialize();owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;owner.waiting=new PluginCall();
  host.captureCallback(new Intent(TestRegistration.PRODUCTION.callback()+(success?"#code=fixture-code&state="+pending.state:"")));
  PluginCall cancel=new PluginCall();cancel.input.put("requestId",REQUEST);host.cancel(cancel);
  while(!host.queued.isEmpty())host.queued.remove().run();
  check(notifications.isEmpty()&&host.requests==0&&!slots.containsKey(host.config().pendingSlot),"a capture queued behind a cancel emits nothing");
 }
 /** An unconfirmed revocation of the replaced key is retried twice in memory; a newer credential action drops the rest. */
 static void revocationRetry(boolean superseded)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();revoked.clear();revocationConfirmed=false;
  try{
   slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("token",OLD).toString());
   CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
   Attempt request=new Attempt(REQUEST);request.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=request;
   PluginCall call=new PluginCall();call.input.put("attemptId",request.id);call.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(call,false);
   check(call.result!=null&&"unconfirmed".equals(call.result.getString("previousSignIn")),"completion is not held for the retries");
   check(Collections.frequency(events,"revoke")==1&&host.main.queue.size()==1,"one inline try, then a scheduled retry");
   if(superseded)host.intent++;
   host.main.drain();
   check(Collections.frequency(events,"revoke")==(superseded?1:3),"retried twice unless superseded");
   check(superseded||host.main.delays.equals(List.of(5000L,25000L)),"retries after 5 s and 30 s");
   for(String value:slots.values())check(!value.contains(OLD),"the replaced key is never written to storage");
   check(!revoked.isEmpty()&&revoked.stream().allMatch(OLD::equals),"every retry revokes the replaced key, never the new one");
  }finally{revocationConfirmed=true;}
 }
 static PluginCall startCode(CloudSignInChainTest host,boolean phone,String address){
  PluginCall start=new PluginCall();start.input.put("environment","production");
  if(phone){start.input.put("phone",address);host.startPhone(start);}else{start.input.put("email",address);host.startEmail(start);}
  return start;
 }
 /** One sign-in at a time: a Google, in-flight or closed sign-in refuses a new code before any request. */
 static void admission()throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();
  for(String live:List.of("google","busy","destroyed"))for(boolean phone:List.of(false,true)){
   CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);host.attempt=owner;
   if(live.equals("google"))owner.google=true;if(live.equals("busy"))owner.busy=true;if(live.equals("destroyed"))host.destroyed=true;
   PluginCall start=startCode(host,phone,phone?"+15555550100":"owner@example.invalid");
   check((live.equals("destroyed")?"unavailable":"login-active").equals(start.error)&&host.attempt==owner&&!owner.cancelled&&host.requests==0,"a "+live+" sign-in refuses a new code");
  }
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
  check("invalid-email".equals(startCode(host,false,"not-an-address").error)&&"invalid-phone".equals(startCode(host,true,"5550100").error)&&host.attempt==null&&host.requests==0,"a malformed address sends nothing");
 }
 /** The send interval holds across addresses and between email and SMS; Cloud's longer deadline holds email. */
 static void sendCooldown()throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();
  check(startCode(host,false,"owner@example.invalid").result!=null&&host.requests==1,"first code sent");
  Attempt sent=host.attempt;
  check("cooldown".equals(startCode(host,false,"other@example.invalid").error)&&"cooldown".equals(startCode(host,true,"+15555550100").error),"another address or method waits out the interval");
  host.lastEmailSendAt-=CloudSignInFlow.RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS;host.emailSendAllowedAt=System.currentTimeMillis()+60000;
  check("cooldown".equals(startCode(host,false,"owner@example.invalid").error),"Cloud's longer resend deadline holds");
  check(host.attempt==sent&&!sent.cancelled&&host.requests==1,"a refused resend keeps the code already sent");
  host.emailSendAllowedAt=0;
  check(startCode(host,false,"owner@example.invalid").result!=null&&host.requests==2&&sent.cancelled,"after the interval a resend goes out");
 }
 /** A wrong code keeps the step until the cap; the cap ends the attempt and no later code is tried. */
 static void wrongCodeCap()throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("token",OLD).toString());
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode="bad-code";
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  for(int tried=1;tried<=CloudSignInFlow.MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS;tried++){
   PluginCall call=new PluginCall();call.input.put("attemptId",owner.id);call.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(call,false);
   boolean last=tried==CloudSignInFlow.MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS;
   check((last?"attempts-exhausted":"invalid-code").equals(call.error)&&(host.attempt==owner)!=last&&(last||!owner.busy&&owner.waiting==null),"wrong code "+tried+" keeps the step until the cap");
  }
  PluginCall after=new PluginCall();after.input.put("attemptId",owner.id);after.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(after,false);
  check("expired".equals(after.error)&&host.requests==CloudSignInFlow.MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS&&!events.contains("key"),"no code is tried after the cap");
  Attempt spent=new Attempt(REQUEST);spent.failedVerifies=CloudSignInFlow.MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS;host.attempt=spent;
  PluginCall late=new PluginCall();late.input.put("attemptId",spent.id);late.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(late,false);
  check("attempts-exhausted".equals(late.error)&&host.attempt==null&&host.requests==CloudSignInFlow.MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS,"a spent attempt refuses before any request");
 }
 /** A verify in flight refuses a second one without replacing its waiting call. */
 static void busyGuard()throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();revoked.clear();slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("token",OLD).toString());
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.defer=true;
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  PluginCall first=new PluginCall();first.input.put("attemptId",owner.id);first.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(first,false);
  PluginCall second=new PluginCall();second.input.put("attemptId",owner.id);second.input.put("code","654321");host.verify(second,false);
  check("login-active".equals(second.error)&&owner.waiting==first&&host.queued.size()==1&&host.requests==0,"a second verify is refused while one is in flight");
  host.queued.remove().run();
  check(first.result!=null&&"authenticated".equals(first.result.optString("status"))&&second.result==null,"only the first verify completes");
 }
 /** Closing the plugin cancels the live attempt; work already on the worker then commits nothing. */
 static void destroyMidVerify()throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();revoked.clear();slots.put("cloud:production",new JSONObject().put("token",OLD).toString());
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.defer=true;
  Attempt owner=new Attempt(REQUEST);owner.credentialGuard=host.reserveCredentialCommit();host.attempt=owner;
  PluginCall call=new PluginCall();call.input.put("attemptId",owner.id);call.input.put("code","123456");host.verify(call,false);
  host.handleOnDestroy();
  check(host.destroyed&&owner.cancelled&&host.attempt==null&&host.worker.shut&&host.prober.shut,"closing cancels the live attempt and stops the workers");
  host.queued.remove().run();
  check(call.result==null&&!events.contains("receipt")&&!events.contains("key")&&!events.contains("ack")&&revoked.isEmpty(),"a verify running at close writes no key");
  check(OLD.equals(new JSONObject(slots.get("cloud:production")).getString("token")),"the saved key is kept");
 }
 /** A receipt from an interrupted ack is acknowledged on the next start only for the key it names, then cleared. */
 static void resumeAcks(String mode)throws Exception{
  slots.clear();events.clear();notifications.clear();
  CloudSignInChainTest host=new CloudSignInChainTest();host.mode=mode;
  CloudSignInEnvironment environment=TestRegistration.PRODUCTION;
  String state=CloudSignInFlow.newState(),verifier=CloudSignInFlow.newVerifier();host.issuedState=state;host.issuedChallenge=CloudSignInFlow.s256(verifier);
  slots.put(host.config().receiptSlot(environment),new JSONObject().put("clientId",host.config().clientId).put("environment",environment.name).put("redirectUri",environment.callback())
   .put("code","emac_"+"a".repeat(64)).put("state",state).put("codeVerifier",verifier).put("credentialId",ID).put("acknowledgeBy",System.currentTimeMillis()+(mode.equals("expired")?-1:30000)).toString());
  String saved=new JSONObject().put("credentialId",REQUEST).put("token",NEW).put("expiresAt",System.currentTimeMillis()+60000).put("serverCredentialId",mode.equals("other-key")?UUID.randomUUID().toString():ID).toString();
  slots.put(host.config().credentialSlot(environment),saved);
  host.resumeAcknowledgements();
  boolean sent=mode.equals("valid")||mode.equals("wrong-ack");
  check(events.contains("ack")==sent&&(!sent||NEW.equals(host.ackedSecret)),"only the key the receipt names is acknowledged: "+mode);
  check(slots.containsKey(host.config().receiptSlot(environment))==mode.equals("wrong-ack"),"an unconfirmed ack keeps the receipt for the next start: "+mode);
  check(saved.equals(slots.get(host.config().credentialSlot(environment))),"the saved key is never touched: "+mode);
 }
 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  changedAfterCommit("intent-after-commit");changedAfterCommit("replacement-after-commit");credentialIdentityReads();
  scenario("valid",true,true);
  for(String mode:List.of("bad-code","invalid-mfa","mfa-denied","mfa-unsupported","config-denied","token-denied","bad-secret","expired-token","missing-ack-contract","cancelled","expired-attempt","superseded","newer-intent","consent-denied"))scenario(mode,false,false);
  scenario("wrong-ack",false,true);
  for(String mode:List.of("cancel-after-commit","destroy-after-commit","replace-after-commit","retained-completion","valid"))completedOwnerScenario(mode,REQUEST);
  completedOwnerScenario("retained-completion",null);
  PluginCall caller=new PluginCall();check(callerRequestId(caller)==null,"legacy request unscoped");
  caller.input.put("requestId",REQUEST);check(REQUEST.equals(callerRequestId(caller)),"valid caller request identity");
  caller.input.put("requestId","not-an-id");boolean refused=false;try{callerRequestId(caller);}catch(SignInFailure invalid){refused=true;}check(refused,"invalid caller identity rejected");
  for(Object value:List.of(42,JSONObject.NULL)){
   caller.input.put("requestId",value);refused=false;try{callerRequestId(caller);}catch(SignInFailure invalid){refused=true;}check(refused,"supplied non-string identity rejected");
  }
  mfaScope(false,false);mfaScope(true,false);mfaScope(false,true);
  browserCallbackRaces();
  callbackOwner("live");callbackOwner("cold-after-signout");callbackOwner("live-after-signout");
  for(String mode:List.of("stale","malformed","matching","legacy","queued","queued-completed"))scopedCancel(mode);
  for(String mode:List.of("send-refused","send-offline","send-ok"))resend(mode,false);
  resend("send-refused",true);resend("send-ok",true);
  returnHint(true);returnHint(false);graceRace("own");graceRace("foreign");graceRace("unreadable");hintGraceRace(true);hintGraceRace(false);queuedBehindCancel(true);queuedBehindCancel(false);
  revocationRetry(false);revocationRetry(true);
  admission();sendCooldown();wrongCodeCap();busyGuard();destroyMidVerify();
  for(String mode:List.of("valid","other-key","expired","wrong-ack"))resumeAcks(mode);
  System.out.println("PASS native sign-in chain (64 scenarios; no browser facilities)");
 }
}
